description:
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Enter the Infinite.
Resolve the first opponent's Enter the Infinite, causing the opponent to draw their library, and then put a card on top of their library.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers for each card they draw this way, dealing damage to the opponent equal to the number of cards they drew.
If the opponent has 0 or less life, they lose the game.
Repeat step 3 for each other opponent.
